subject: Avicenna license upgrade
body:
Dear Jasmina,


I hope you are doing well.


My name is Sara from Avicenna and I'm reaching out to you to help you with your recent license upgrade request for your project, "Menstruationszyklus und Borderline".


Generally, our pricing depends on three factors:
  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well)
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study)
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll

I would be able to help you better if you could share more information about your study with me. 


Additionally, in case you would like to add this study to the "University of Innsbruck" license, it should be approved/confirmed by Yashvin Seetahul <Yashvin.Seetahul@uibk.ac.at> or Lucas Maunz <Lucas.Maunz@uibk.ac.at>. Please send an email and share your study ID with them. Upon their approval, your study will be upgraded within an hour.


Hope this helps,

Best,

Sara
